title: Tidy git log: drop empty lines
brief: A raw git log has blank lines between commits. Delete every completely empty line to compact the history for a release note.
text:
commit a1b2c3
Author: dev
Date: 2026-11-27
    fix login bug

commit d4e5f6
Author: qa
Date: 2026-11-26
    add tests

commit g7h8i9
Author: ops
Date: 2026-11-25
    deploy v2

expect.text:
commit a1b2c3
Author: dev
Date: 2026-11-27
    fix login bug
commit d4e5f6
Author: qa

commit g7h8i9

why: The global command :g matches every line fitting a pattern and runs an Ex command on it. /^$/ finds blank lines; d deletes them all in one pass.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use a global command to target blank lines.
